Access & accountability

Staff & activity.

Give staff access only to the work they need and keep a record of important changes.

i
Staff access is not configured.This preview does not provide a protected admin login or change log.

Recommended staff roles

Assign roles to individual staff accounts; avoid shared admin passwords.

Owner / administratorAll settings, member records, staff access, reports, and audit history.
Membership staffMember records, applications, renewal follow-up, and profile support.
Finance staffPayment status, receipts, refunds, dues reporting, and financial exports.
Events staffEvent setup, attendees, check-in, capacity, and event reports.
Content moderatorDirectory submissions, classifieds queue, reports, and takedowns.
Read-only reviewerView assigned records and reports without changing member data.
